data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Guard MUST run on post-leaf, pre-execution mutation list (wrap per-leaf dispatch result) such that every leaf's emitted dso-id-* label mutation passes through the guard regardless of which leaf produced it. Add RED test: call apply() with an UNAUTHORIZED leaf returning a synthetic dso-id-* label mutation → DsoIdLabelWriteError raised. Without pinning the invocation site, future refactor could regress silently (implicit_assumption).
